verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a native bank-account connection covering over 4,000 banks and neobanks, and bank payments can be matched to invoices in the bookkeeping. The banking leg of the story is clearly delivered. Payments and payroll are covered only by a generic claim that partner integrations "transfer data automatically", with no named payment-processor or payroll connector. Missing for 10: documented payment-processor connections (e.g. card/online payment providers), documented payroll integration flowing into the ledger, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic transaction import.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk. We already support over 4,000 banks and neobanks.
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
Expand your features with a wide range of partner integrations. Use interfaces to work more efficiently and transfer data automatically.
